Allow supported template WebDAV methods through the strict firewall (#1016)
Permit PROPFIND, LOCK and UNLOCK only on the canonical template DAV collection after StrictHttpFirewall validation. Preserve normal method/path, authentication, authorization and CSRF boundaries.
Exact head 3ec32745e6bd7ed2c34cc1675f4967f699d7d11d passed complete CI/CD 34045005805, Database Compatibility, Security, Kubernetes, document E2E and CodeQL PUSH. Review 5125924684 recommends approval for all four files; both inline threads are resolved. Original current-head JUnit XML confirms five full-HTTP and four firewall tests without failures, errors or skips.
Fixes #1013. Refs #964, #826, #830. This fixes the server-side firewall defect, not desktop Word, proxy, Keycloak or clustered-client certification.
